references.text: Here is a more detailed description of the duties of Merari's sons, including carrying the boards, bars, pillars, and bases of the tabernacle.
Moses gave four carts and eight oxen to Merari's sons to transport the heavy parts of the tabernacle that were their responsibility.
Description of the boards, bars, pillars, and bases of the tabernacle for which Merari's sons were responsible.
The account of the actual making of the boards, bars, and bases that Merari's sons were to keep.
Introduction to the clans of Merari's sons, Mahli and Mushi, who were assigned these duties.
During the wilderness journey, the sons of Gershon and Merari carried the tabernacle when the camp broke up.
